scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files

scenarios.reasoning: The agent successfully identified the failing projects, scale of errors, target frameworks, and concentration in HotReload files. However, it misidentified the dominant error codes as FS0001 when the rubric indicates FS0039/FS0072 dominate. The agent was hampered by not being able to read the large output files (the saved temp files weren't accessible), so it had to rely on partial information from the tool results. The approach was reasonable but the inability to access the detailed error output led to an inaccurate characterization of the error types.
